title: Prune only implied literals in proof trimming and reject failed probes
summary: The native proof trimmer now unassigns only the literal a removed clause justifies, raises an explicit error when a probe finds no unit-propagation conflict, and the Python exporter falls back to the untrimmed log with a warning. The QF_UFLIA benchmarks hard16 and hard20 go from export-rejected to Lean-verified.
